Class GatedAttention

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.model.qwen.GatedAttention
All Implemented Interfaces:
Attention
public class GatedAttention extends Object implements Attention
Qwen3.5 gated full attention (GQA + partial RoPE + sigmoid output gate).

The query projection emits twice the head channels; the second half is a per-token sigmoid gate applied to the attention output before o_proj.

Under tensor parallelism, Q/K/V projections are column-sharded by heads and o_proj is row-parallel (all-reduce after the projection).

    • forward

      public Tensor forward(Tensor x, int[] positions, Tensor cos, Tensor sin, Tensor mask)
      Decode with per-row cache write positions (seqLen == 1), uniform prefill/verify when every row shares the same positions[0], or a genuinely ragged multi-token verify window (concurrent requests at different absolute positions, seqLen > 1) via forwardVerifyRagged(Tensor, int[], Tensor, Tensor).
      Parameters:
      x - hidden states [B, S, D].
      positions - absolute write position per batch row.
      cos - cosines [S, R] or per-row [B, S, R].
      sin - sines with the same layout as cos.
      mask - causal mask; ignored by the ragged verify path (that kernel's causal masking is unconditional), used otherwise, or null for decode.
      Returns:
      attention output.
